verdict.rationale: Jira is an issue and project tracker. It neither authors nor hosts git commits, so enforcing SSH/GPG signing on AI-authored commits is a source-control and coding-agent axis, not one that fits this product type. The evidence only shows Jira handing work off to external coding agents, not producing commits itself, so the wrong-axis exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
